dedupe_keys.name: stations de traitement des eaux usees france entiere

description: Stations de traitement des eaux usées - France entière is a dataset listed in Sandre, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by api.sandre.eaufrance.fr. The waste water treatment system is a structure for the remediation of waste water by various processes: biological, physico-chemical... located on a continuous and homogeneous geographical space. It is urban, industrial or mixed depending on the nature of the client. Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "Wastewater treatment plants - France Entire" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include odp, OUVRAGE DE DEPOLLUTION, hvd, STATION D'EPURATION, données ouvertes, SIE. The listing shows 6 download or service links in WMS, WFS. The listing shows 2023-12-31 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://inspire.ec.europa.eu/metadata-codelist/%20ConditionsApplyingToAccessAndUse/noConditionsApply). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-sandre.
